Subject: Pricing and migration economics for EdgeLeaf pilot

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the intro call yesterday. We re-run a lot of inference internally and are evaluating a potential vendor switch for our customer-facing embedding and rerank pipelines. A few things we need from you to evaluate a match:

- Can you provide a per-token and per-embedding price (hosted) and the committed-rate pricing for Dedicated (1yr / 3yr)?
- We have an incumbent offering a 30% blended discount plus a six-month migration credit. Can Redwood match or propose an equivalent concession?
- Any quant or latency deltas we should budget for (we're sensitive at <60ms p95 for short chat queries)?

I attached a one-week usage snapshot (EdgeLeaf_usage_snapshot.csv) — mostly short queries, ~120M tokens/month, embeddings at ~25k/month.

Can you send a proposal and rough timeline by EOD Thursday?

Best,
Daniel
Account Executive
EdgeLeaf Inc

Hi Daniel —

Appreciate the usage snapshot. Quick summary up front: yes, we can structure a competitive match that balances short-term credits with a committed-rate cadence. Attached is a short deck with our pricing bands (redwood_pricing_options.pdf). Key items:

- Hosted API: list pricing, then volume tiers we typically apply.
- Dedicated (reserved): 1yr and 3yr commit options with deeper discounts and predictable throughput.
- Migration assistance: pilot credit + engineering support for KV/cache priming and data export scripts.

To make the match tight, we need the following from you:
1) confirmation of your incumbent effective price (blended) and any contract language that looks like an early-exit credit.
2) target SLA and whether private/VPC networking is required for go-live.
3) expected go-live window for pilot and full migration.

If you prefer, we can propose two options:
A) Short pilot (6 months): 25% off hosted + $XXk migration credit + 2 dedicated support sprints.
B) Committed path (12 mo): 35% off hosted or equivalent commit discount on Dedicated + onboarding credit + migration runbook assistance.

I'll loop in our pricing lead for final numbers — copied Priyom and Soojin for the econ and compliance checks.

Would you be available for a 30-minute follow-up Fri 8/20 to walk the numbers?

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop

Lauren —
Short answer: we can match economically but not on every line item. Recommendation below (conservative for approval):

Pilot option (6 months) —
- 25% off hosted list for first 6 months (applies to generation + embeddings).
- $50k migration credit applied as invoice offset across first 3 invoices.
- 2 dedicated engineering sprints (up to 10 engineer-days) to prime caches and mitigate latency risk.

Committed option (12 months) —
- 35% off hosted list OR equivalent 30% discount on Dedicated with 12-mo reservation (guaranteed nodes).
- $75k one-time onboarding credit for Dedicated migrations (covers data transfer and engineering time).
- SLA add-on: 99.9% for committed path; Private deployment available as a paid option (compliance add-on).

Notes and guardrails:
- Margin impact: pilot option estimated to reduce gross margin by ~8-10 pts; committed option by ~6 pts but recovers via commit.
- Latency: with their profile, hosted should meet <60ms p95 for short queries if we reserve adequate capacity and enable prefix caching. Dedicated gives more predictability for p95.
- Legal: avoid a blanket early-exit rebate that amortizes longer than 12 months; prefer invoice offsets.

If this looks good I can draft the concession language for the swap terms.

—Rishi
VP, Revenue Operations (acting)

Subject: Redwood competitive offer and next steps (EdgeLeaf)

Hi Daniel / EdgeLeaf procurement —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Based on the usage you shared and our internal economics review, Redwood can offer the following two pathways to match the incumbent economics and minimize migration risk:

Option 1 — Pilot (recommended for initial validation)
- 25% off hosted rates for 6 months (generation + embeddings).
- $50,000 migration credit applied as invoice offsets across the first 3 invoices.
- Two dedicated onboarding sprints (up to 10 engineer-days) to handle cache priming, KV migration, and latency tuning.
- No long-term commitment required; standard T&Cs apply.

Option 2 — Committed (recommended for predictable unit cost)
- 35% off hosted list price for 12 months OR equivalent 30% on Dedicated with a 12-month reserved commitment.
- $75,000 one-time onboarding credit (applied at invoice #1).
- SLA: 99.9% for committed contracts. Private/VPC networking available (additional compliance add-on).

Technical notes:
- With prefix/KV caching enabled and one Dedicated node for peak bursts, we expect to meet the <60ms p95 target for short queries.
- We'll provide an ops runbook for model quantization guidance and batching knobs to keep costs aligned.

Next steps:
1) Confirm which option you prefer (Pilot vs Committed) and share any legal must-haves.
2) If agreed, we will send the swap term sheet (redwood_swap_terms_v1.pdf) and a short TCO workbook pre-filled (edgeleaf_tco_spreadsheet.xlsx) for your review.
3) Schedule a 30-min handoff call to align on timeline and technical owners.

I've attached the draft concession language and the TCO workbook for your review. Please let me know if Friday 8/20 10:00am PT works for a quick walkthrough.

Cheers,
Lauren Bishop
